_comment: Live trigger eval-set for agentic-sdlc-pipeline. Positives = natural-language production-impacting end-to-end/full-envelope requests; negatives = narrow review/test/refactor requests.

queries.query: Production etkisi olan yeni odeme akisini spec, plan, TDD, security review ve final audit ile uctan uca gelistir.
Musteri-facing CSV export degisikligini disciplined SDLC akisi ile bastan sona, PR-ready sekilde uygula.
Add a backend audit-log export feature end to end with spec, plan, tests, security review, and a PR-ready diff.
Sadece bu diff icin code review yap.
